# ZKProofport on Arc

Source-backed design simulation, not a deployed Arc application.

- [Research and implementation gaps](RESEARCH.md)
- [Structured review evidence](review.json)
- [Running the visualizer and tests](README.md)
- [Executable simulation and authorization specification](app.js)
- [Focused specification tests](test.cjs)

Official platform addresses are not project deployment evidence. Project agent IDs, verifier/vault addresses and transaction hashes are unknown/null. The UI makes no network calls; all positive and rejected outcomes are simulated.

The proposed product buys Coinbase KYC proofs using Circle Agent Stack and Gateway Nanopayments, then conditionally executes a USDC action on Arc. Current source-wallet unlinkability, TEE deployment and action-binding gaps are documented in RESEARCH.md.
